IC1: Subject must have a diagnosis of COPD [AND] based on the American Thoracic Society (ATS)/ European Respiratory Society (ERS) criteria.
IC2: Male [OR] or female subjects, aged >=40 years. Females [AND] must be of [NOT] Non Child Bearing Potential. The definition of [NOT] Non Child Bearing Potential is as following: Females, regardless of their age, with functioning ovaries and who have a current documented tubal ligation [OR] or hysterectomy [OR], or females who are post-menopausal.
IC3: Have diagnosed COPD [AND] stage III or IV according to GOLD criteria: a baseline post-bronchodilator Forced Expiratory Volume, measured at 1 second (FEV1) <50% of predicted normal and a baseline post- bronchodilator FEV1/Inspiratory Vital Capacity (IVC) ratio <70%.
IC4: Have experienced at least 2 moderate [OR] or severe COPD exacerbations leading to medical consultation (requiring oral corticosteroids [OR] or increasing dosage of oral corticosteroids [OR] and/or antibiotics [OR] or hospitalization) within the 12 months preceding Visit 1.
IC5: Have stable COPD medication within 4 weeks prior to Visit 1 (no new medication added and no dosage changes in medication).
IC6: Current [OR] or ex-smokers with a smoking history of at least 10 pack years (number of pack years = [number of cigarettes per day / 20] x number of years smoked, e.g., 20 cigarettes per day for 10 years, or 10 cigarettes per day for 20 years).
IC7: Are currently managed  at home (outpatients), are ambulatory [AND] and able to travel to the clinic. Subjects can be treated with all relevant COPD medication [OR]. This includes vaccines [OR], inhaled short-acting beta-2-agonists [OR] as needed, short-acting [OR] or long-acting anticholinergics [OR] (tiotropium), systemic beta-2-agonists [OR], theophylline [OR], mucolytics [OR], antioxidants, beta-1-agonists [AND] (for cardiovascular indication), non-invasive ventilation [OR], long term oxygen therapy [OR] and can have Cor Pulmonale.
IC8: A signed and dated written informed consent is obtained prior to participation.
IC9: Able to comply with the requirements of the protocol and be available for study visits over 52 weeks.
